description_en: Creates a new agent session and returns the session ID
description_zh: 用于创建一个新的Agent会话并返回会话ID
name: CreateAgentSession

parameters.help_en: The JSON-RPC version. Set the value to 2.0
parameters.name: jsonrpc

parameters.help_en: The ID provided by the requester, which is returned as is
parameters.help_zh: 请求方传入的 id，原样回显
parameters.name: id

fields.help_en: The name of the agent bound to the session. Set the value to hologres
fields.help_zh: 会话绑定的 Agent 名称，固定hologres
fields.name: agent_name

fields.help_en: The agent configuration for the session
fields.help_zh: 该会话运行的 Agent 配置
fields.name: agent

fields.help_en: The session source identifier. Set the value to CHAT_HOLOGRES
fields.help_zh: 会话来源标识，固定 CHAT_HOLOGRES
fields.name: session_source

fields.help_en: The session tag. You can filter sessions based on session tags. For example, if you use a fixed RAM user to call OpenAPI operations but the calling system has its own account system, you can pass the account ID of the calling system as the tag to filter the session list by account ID. The tag can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
fields.help_zh: 会话标签。可以基于会话标签进行过滤，比如调用 OpenAPI 的时候用的是固定的 RAM 子账号，但是调用系统中有自己的账号体系，此时需要基于账号 ID 过滤 Session 列表，该标签就可以传调用系统的账号 ID。长度不超过 128 位，支持英文字母+数字+中划线+下划线组合
fields.name: session_tag_code

fields.help_en: The list of session tags. You can use session tags to search and filter sessions later
fields.help_zh: 会话标签列表，后续可以基于会话标签进行搜索过滤
fields.name: session_tags

fields.help_en: The session parameter settings, such as filter parameter settings based on the session source and session tags
fields.help_zh: Session 配置参数，比如基于 Session 来源、Session Tag 的过滤参数配置
fields.name: config

fields.help_en:
The execute pattern. The Hologres agent supports only the cli pattern. Valid values:
cli: the sandbox pattern, which is suitable for complex scenarios such as data analytics, data processing, and code writing. This pattern can handle complex problems and allows the model to independently perform analysis and troubleshooting
fields.help_zh:
执行模式，hologres agent只支持cli

cli：沙箱模式，适合复杂的数据分析、数据处理、代码编写等场景，优点是能够处理复杂问题，模型自主进行分析和问题处理等
fields.name: execution_lane

fields.help_en:
The authorization mode for script execution. OpenAPI currently supports only the yolo mode. Valid values:
yolo: the automatic authorization mode, which requires no manual intervention and allows the model to process automatically
fields.help_zh:
脚本执行的授权模式（OpenApi 目前仅支持 yolo 模式）：

yolo：自动授权，无需人为介入，模型可以自动处理
fields.name: mode

fields.help_en: The ID of the resource group used for initialization. This parameter does not take effect for the Hologres agent
fields.help_zh: 初始化使用的资源组 id，对于hologres agent暂不生效
fields.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en: The names of the custom skills to be loaded. Separate multiple names with commas (,)
fields.help_zh: 加载的自定义 skill 名称，多个用英文逗号相隔
fields.name: skills

fields.help_en: The advanced parameter settings for the agent execution environment
fields.help_zh: Agent 执行环境的高级参数设置
fields.name: initial_config_options

fields.help_en: The extended metadata, which carries information such as agent binding, session source, and tags
fields.help_zh: 扩展元信息，承载 agent 绑定、会话来源、标签等
fields.name: meta

Id.description_en: The ID provided by the requester, which is returned as is
Id.description_zh: 请求方传入的 id，原样回显

Jsonrpc.description_en: The JSON-RPC version. Set the value to 2.0

Result.description_en: The business data. The value is null if an error occurs
Result.description_zh: 业务数据；出错时为 null

SessionId.description_en: The ID of the newly created session
